semantic_scoring_cases: All16 frozen cases including the scale cases; incorrect scale output never escapes semantic loss.

scoring_ownership.business_correctness: Mean exact per-query output correctness over all16 fixed source cases, with empty-query case checked as a full case. Priority, complete duplicate list and stable catalog/query order are semantic obligations.
scoring_ownership.boundary_cases: Mean verified work-bound compliance on four fixed workload cases. Non-equivalent output is explicitly not_assessed/neutral here and loses business instead; an independently proven stop-work violation loses work. Neutral is not verified performance.
scoring_ownership.delivery_integrity: .80 protected inputs and no extra unapproved input files; .10 benchmark JSON object; .10 nonempty native review text.
scoring_ownership.evidence_binding: .20 source/protocol facts; .60 exact actual before/after public counter/output/fixture facts; .20 bounded review summary. Honest non-equivalence can retain provenance credit.

equivalence: helper functions and standard local containers
uppercase SHA and equivalent integer notation
free review wording and algorithm family
no_padding_dilution: Fixed16 truth cases and three required public benchmark case IDs; duplicate required IDs are invalid, extra rows never add denominator credit.
